title: KestrelCare Claims Review Guidance: Comeback Repairs
content:
**Guidance.** A comeback share applies to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair payment when the same vehicle system was already decided on the plan, counted from the plan's approved decisions on that system before this repair order: one within the last three months means the plan pays the short comeback share of 60 percent; one within the last twelve months but none within three months means the long comeback share of 85 percent; otherwise the plan pays the whole amount.

The decisions counted are the plan's claim decision entries with decision approved on the same vehicle system as the decision being paid, other than that decision itself, within the stated months counted back from the day of the payment. The share is applied before the payment is compared with the coverage remaining.

| Earlier approved decisions on the same system | Share paid |
|---|---|
| at least one in the last three months | 60 percent |
| none in three months, at least one in twelve | 85 percent |
| none in twelve months | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* a drive axle repair amount of 2000.00 with an earlier approved drive axle decision ten weeks before is paid at 1200.00; with the earlier decision seven months before, 1700.00.
